sections.h2: Frequently Asked Questions — On-Page SEO Services Kochi

items.q: What's the difference between on-page SEO and technical SEO?
items.a: On-page SEO focuses on individual page elements — titles, headings, content, internal links. Technical SEO covers how search engines crawl and index the site as a whole. Both need to work together, but they solve different problems.

items.q: Will optimizing my content make it sound unnatural or keyword-stuffed?
items.a: No, not if it's done correctly. Content optimization for SEO should read naturally to a visitor first — if a change makes content sound forced, it's the wrong optimization, regardless of keyword targeting.

items.q: Do you rewrite existing content, or just adjust structure?
items.a: Both, depending on what's needed. Some pages just need better headings and internal links; others need genuine content rewrites through our SEO copywriting services Kochi when the existing content is too thin to rank.

items.q: How is keyword placement decided for each page?
items.a: Keyword placement optimization follows where search engines weight terms most — titles, opening content, and subheadings — while making sure the same keyword isn't targeted by two competing pages.

items.q: Does schema markup really help on-page SEO?
items.a: Yes. Schema markup for on-page SEO can improve how a page appears in search results — FAQ rich snippets, review stars, or structured data that AI answer engines can read more easily.

items.q: How long does on-page optimization take to show results?
items.a: Changes are often visible faster than technical or link-building work, sometimes within 4–8 weeks, though results depend on competition for the target keyword.
